# Njure Tech (https://tech.njuregroup.in)

> Njure Tech is a client-budget-oriented Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) and remote operations company under Njure Group. It operates a 100% remote model with zero agency cut, sharing project profits directly with frontline remote specialists as business partners.

## Core Entity Details
- Legal Brand: Njure Tech
- Parent Organization: Njure Group (https://njuregroup.in)
- Official Domain: https://tech.njuregroup.in
- Central Inquiries Email: info@njuregroup.in
- Operating Model: 100% Remote & Distributed Workforce Across India
- Business Hours: 24/7 Follow-the-Sun Operations
- Primary Languages: English, Malayalam, Hindi, Tamil

## Core BPO Services & Canonical URLs
- Omnichannel Customer Support Outsourcing: https://tech.njuregroup.in/services/customer-support
  - Sub-2 minute live chat & phone answer speed, email ticketing, WhatsApp Business API, and Tier-1 technical troubleshooting across Zendesk, Freshdesk, Jira Service Management, and Zoho Desk.
- Back-Office Operations & Data Processing: https://tech.njuregroup.in/services/back-office
  - KYC document verification, product catalog indexing, vendor invoice audits, and spreadsheet deduplication with dual-pass 99.5%+ accuracy.
- E-Commerce Support & RTO Reduction: https://tech.njuregroup.in/services/ecommerce-support
  - Cash-on-Delivery (COD) phone/WhatsApp confirmation, Non-Delivery Report (NDR) triage, courier delay escalation, and returns processing reducing Return-to-Origin by 25%–35%.
- Telecalling & Inbound Lead Qualification: https://tech.njuregroup.in/services/telecalling
  - Speed-to-lead contact within 10 minutes, discovery meeting booking on sales rep calendars, NPS surveys, and renewal reminder calling.
- BPO Services Directory Overview: https://tech.njuregroup.in/services

## Operating Model & Zero Agency Cut Economics
- URL: https://tech.njuregroup.in/about
- URL: https://tech.njuregroup.in/operations
- Traditional agencies take 50%–70% of client fees for corporate margins and physical office leases.
- Njure Tech operates without commercial real estate overhead and takes zero agency cut, passing project profits directly to remote specialists as business partners.
- Results: Sub-2 minute SLAs, near-zero turnover, authentic dedication, and open-book transparency.

## Security Controls & Compliance Posture
- URL: https://tech.njuregroup.in/security
- Transparent Disclosure: Njure Tech is currently not ISO 27001 or SOC 2 certified.
- Operational Controls:
  - Workstations with locked down USB ports, application whitelisting, and clean-screen standards.
  - Client-controlled identity (SSO/MFA) with instant one-click revocation authority.
  - Bilateral legally enforceable NDAs signed by every specialist.
  - Continuous supervisor-level queue monitoring and QA audits.
  - Onboarding security review prior to production access.
